To represent the life, philosophy, and influence of Aristotle, here is a structured list of information expressed as (subject, predicate, object) triples.

### Biographical Facts
* (Aristotle, born in, Stagira)
* (Aristotle, studied at, Plato’s Academy)
* (Aristotle, tutored, Alexander the Great)
* (Aristotle, founded, the Lyceum)
* (Aristotle, founded, the Peripatetic school)
* (Aristotle, died in, Chalcis)

### Philosophical Foundations
* (Aristotle, emphasized, empiricism)
* (Aristotle, rejected, Plato’s Theory of Forms)
* (Aristotle, advocated for, the Golden Mean)
* (Aristotle, defined, virtue as a habit)
* (Aristotle, prioritized, teleology)
* (Aristotle, studied, substance and essence)

### Contributions to Logic and Science
* (Aristotle, invented, formal logic)
* (Aristotle, developed, the syllogism)
* (Aristotle, classified, biological species)
* (Aristotle, categorized, physical elements)
* (Aristotle, wrote, the Organon)
* (Aristotle, theorized, the four causes)

### Literary and Scientific Works
* (Aristotle, authored, Nicomachean Ethics)
* (Aristotle, authored, Politics)
* (Aristotle, authored, Physics)
* (Aristotle, authored, Metaphysics)
* (Aristotle, authored, Poetics)
* (Aristotle, authored, De Anima)

### Historical Influence
* (Western philosophy, influenced by, Aristotle)
* (Scholasticism, based upon, Aristotelian logic)
* (Thomas Aquinas, synthesized, Christianity and Aristotelianism)
* (Islamic Golden Age scholars, preserved, Aristotelian texts)
* (The Scientific Revolution, challenged, Aristotelian physics)
* (Modern biology, traces roots to, Aristotle)

### Metaphysical Concepts
* (The Four Causes, include, Material cause)
* (The Four Causes, include, Formal cause)
* (The Four Causes, include, Efficient cause)
* (The Four Causes, include, Final cause)
* (Aristotle, defined, the soul as the form of the body)
* (Aristotle, posited, the Prime Mover)
